items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: I have no problem emulating Fred White, Earth, Wind and Fire, that drummer, great drummer just passed away recently

ctx.x: Yes. And that’s a point of departure, you know and at that moment — somebody said, “You’re very diplomatic.” So my diplomacy kind of kicks in and detente comes to mind

where okay they don’t want me to do what I do naturally or instinctually or what I prepared to do when I first heard about this song or this album. So leave all that behind and start fresh. And I take their direction or the producer’s direction, you know, don’t do this, do this, can you make it sound like this, can you make it go faster, slower, louder, softer. Can you play with brushes? Can you play with — whatever the suggestions might be you take it all in and process it and then go forward with that. You…
It’s funny you mentioned Bernard Purdie because he told me if someone said, “I want you to sound like Steve Gadd he would have said, “Well go get Steve Gadd then.”
